description: The face of Salvage Rites. A chain-link gate on a rolling track, topped with wire that has caught more carrier bags than intruders, and a hand-painted board wired to it: SALVAGE RITES · WE BUY ANYTHING · WE ASK NOTHING · CASH, NOT FEELINGS. Beyond the mesh: rust-coloured bales of crushed car stacked in uneven rows, and the yellow arm of a grabber crane standing over them like it is presiding. The gate is open. It is always open. There is nothing in there worth stealing that you could carry.
name: Salvage Rites
